scaleDecision: The head stays upright, as on main. The temporal bone is rotated into that head: 30.8° in all (27° yaw about head-superior and 15° pitch about head-lateral). Scale is 1. The bony porus lies on the cavum conchae axis.

current.method: Rigid rotation of the specimen into the upright head. rmsMm is the distance between independently defined landmark pairs.

pairs.method: Each point is defined on its own model. The specimen point is rotated into the upright head. Residual is the distance between those two definitions.

concha.definition: Cavum conchae: medial floor of the inferior bowl of the auricle, on the unmoved pinna.

umeyama.note: Scale is fixed at 1. rmsMm is the matched-pair residual of the specimen rotation.

dimensions.source: Singh et al., J Anat Soc India morphometry, mean total length 7.915 mm (n=120). Compared with the longest vertex chord. Acceptance is |z| < 2.5. A CBCT series (Natl J Maxillofac Surg 2024) reported range 4.5–9.0 mm.

Lopes et al., Research Society and Development 2021, male porion–mastoidale mean about 32 mm (right 31.63 SD 3.09, left 32.96 SD 2.93). This value is the vertical drop from the canal centroid, not caliper porion, so it is only a scale check.

Howells cranial length. Egyptian male mean GOL 185.6 mm and Norse male mean 188.5 mm (Howells craniometric set). SD 8 mm stands in for cross-population spread. Glabella and opisthocranion here are the anterior and posterior midline vault vertices.

Bizygomatic breadth. Howells male examples are about 133–134 mm; a Brazilian male mean is 128.2 mm SD 5.5 (Lopes 2021). SD 6 mm is the acceptance window. Measured across the zygomatic arches, not the clavicles.
Adult auricular length is commonly near 60 mm. SD 5 mm flags only a large miss. This is cartilage height, top of helix to lobule.
Same porion–mastoidale reference as the ZETA drop. Skull porion is the lateral meatus rim, so this is closer to the caliper definition than the canal centroid.

frameNote: Head meshes are the upright main models. Specimen meshes are rotated into that frame.
